# freecenter_vswitch (Resource)

A standard virtual switch of a host. It can only be destroyed once it has no port groups.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `host_id` (String)
- `name` (String)

### Optional

- `uplinks` (Set of String) Physical adapters of the switch (e.g. vmnic1), not in use by another switch. Without uplinks the switch is internal to the host.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) <host_id>/<name>.
- `mtu` (Number)
